-- stdout --
OVERVIEW: Show the current session: sign-in time, expiry and time left.

USAGE: gatekeepr status [--log-dir <path>] [--json] [--short] [--warn <duration>]

OPTIONS:
  --log-dir <path>        Where Appgate writes driver.log. (default:
                          /var/log/appgate)
  --json                  Print JSON instead of text.
  --short                 Print only the time left, like 6h08m, for statuslines.
  --warn <duration>       Exit with 1 when this much time or less is left, e.g.
                          30m, 2h, 1h30m. (default: 30m)
  --version               Show the version.
  -h, --help              Show help information.

-- stderr --
-- swift-stdout --
